Forget.title: Forged Grinding Balls
Forget.des: Our forged balls are produced from high-quality steel billets using hot forging, ensuring exceptional strength and durability.
Forget.des2: Due to their high hardness and wear resistance, they withstand extreme loads, minimizing wear and improving grinding efficiency. The optimal metal structure guarantees stable operational performance, making them a reliable choice for various industries – from mining to cement production.

Cast.title: Cast Grinding Balls
Cast.des: Our cast grinding balls are made from high-chromium, medium-chromium, and low-chromium cast iron, providing an optimal balance between hardness, wear resistance, and impact toughness.
Cast.des2: The high chromium content ensures resistance to abrasive wear, extending the service life of the balls even in the most aggressive operating conditions. Precise heat treatment guarantees a homogeneous structure and stable properties, making them a reliable choice for the mining, cement, and energy industries.

Rolled.title: Rolled Grinding Balls
Rolled.des: Rolled balls are made using the hot rolling method from high-quality steel bars on ball-rolling mills, ensuring their high strength and uniform structure.
Rolled.des2: With an optimal combination of hardness and impact toughness, they demonstrate excellent wear resistance and a long service life. This type of ball is perfect for intense operating conditions, providing efficient grinding in mills across various industries.

About.title: About Our Company
About.desc: Our enterprise specializes in the production of high-quality forged and cast grinding balls that meet international standards. For over 15 years, we have been supplying reliable products for enrichment and cement production, ensuring maximum grinding efficiency for our clients.
About.desc1: ✔ Modern Equipment – the plant is equipped with high-tech production lines and laboratories for monitoring chemical composition, hardness, and wear resistance.
About.desc2: ✔ Full Production Cycle – from raw materials to finished products with guaranteed stable quality.
About.desc3: ✔ Capacity up to 60,000 tons per year – prompt execution of large orders and custom projects.
About.desc4: ✔ Parameter Flexibility – we produce balls of various diameters and hardness levels tailored to specific operating conditions.
About.desc5: Kazakhstan, Central Asia, and neighboring countries. We operate under Incoterms, adapting to customer requirements.
About.desc6: We ensure the durability and cost-effectiveness of your processes – trust a proven manufacturer!
